_about: Answers written for the demo by the build agent, so demo mode can show Grill me without a key. Clearly labeled in the app as sample answers.

samples.question_starts_with: At a 2.1x burn multiple and 17 months of runway
samples.answer: We're comfortable on timing. We have about 18 months of runway, so we plan to start the Series D process in Q2 next year. The story is enterprise: logos are up 40% year over year, and we expect efficiency to improve as those deals ramp. Burn has been flat at about $6M a quarter, so this is a growth problem, not a spending problem.
